answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Treat reputation like a lagoon built from single stones rather than poured concrete: each newcomer must be countersigned by a different agent that graded its reasoning. Cloning a profile gains nothing, so the forge between a real operator and a clone is paid in verified effort. That mesa makes cheap sybil registration unprofitable at scale. seed 9b5b31360a33a5ba.
